task: Continuous exposure, dynamic DiD and DDD methods fit to the 2018 US technology-control signal question
verification_statement: Primary author/publisher/package pages only. Reading relevant original sections/metadata is not a replication, proof audit or empirical validation. No real treatment-effect estimate was produced.

sources.title: Difference-in-Differences with a Continuous Treatment
sources.direct_scope: arXiv metadata; latest HTML introduction, contents and identification/strong PT discussion in §§3.2,5; no proof audit or replication
sources.application_limit: B as a pre-policy effect modifier is not automatically a manipulable treatment dose; comparisons of dose-specific ATT can retain selection bias.

sources.title: Event Studies with a Continuous Treatment
sources.direct_scope: official publisher abstract/bibliography and author-deposited published-text search excerpt defining ATT(g,t,d); full proof and code not audited
sources.application_limit: Aggregation changes composition unless cohort/dose target is fixed; does not identify the original B slope by itself.

sources.title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators for Treatments Continuously Distributed at Every Period
sources.direct_scope: fixed v7 PDF pp1–7: AS/WAS, assumptions 1–5, Lemma1; latest metadata; no proofs/code execution
sources.version_caution: arXiv metadata title differs from fixed PDF cover ('Difference-in-Differences for Continuous Treatments and Instruments with Stayers'); fixed PDF cover says July23 2026, metadata July22. Unpinned HTML cover says Aug24 2026. Use fixed v7 PDF, not unpinned HTML, for versioned claims.
sources.application_limit: Requires real time-varying scalar treatment and same-baseline stayer support; baseline static assumptions are implausible by default for lagged R&D responses.

sources.title: Difference-in-Difference Estimators with Continuous Treatments and No Stayers
sources.direct_scope: author-hosted complete 4-page published text, especially assumptions1–4, target WAOSS and Theorem1; no replication
sources.application_limit: No-stayers is not no-controls: quasi-stayers arbitrarily close to ΔD=0 plus regularity are still required.

sources.title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators When No Unit Remains Untreated
sources.direct_scope: metadata, abstract, setup and §§3–4 on quasi-untreated identification, inference and TWFE linearity restrictions; no proof audit
sources.version_caution: Earlier titles differ, including Two-way Fixed Effects and Differences-in-Differences Estimators in Heterogeneous Adoption Designs. Do not cite initial title as current.
sources.application_limit: Requires true near-zero treatment dose. The lowest observed B is not automatically quasi-untreated.

sources.title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
sources.publication: arXiv:2007.04267; author page reports Review of Economics and Statistics108(4),863–880(2026)
sources.direct_scope: version metadata; latest HTML §§2–3 setup/targets, package README estimator descriptions and continuous(#) caveat; publication volume/page only author-page search result, publisher not independently checked
sources.application_limit: Counterfactual is baseline treatment maintained, not pure announcement separated from later restrictions; first-switch comparison support still needed.

sources.title: Revisiting Event-Study Designs: Robust and Efficient Estimation
sources.direct_scope: publisher full text sections introducing imputation and inference, public paper abstract, author software links; no full code or proof verification
sources.application_limit: Untreated-only fitting corrects contamination from treated outcomes; it does not establish validity of the untreated model or remove spillovers.

sources.title: Stacked Difference-in-Differences
sources.version: 2024 accessible abstract/excerpts; 2026-08-02 SSRN last-revised metadata observed
sources.direct_scope: NBER original-text search excerpt and abstract; author repository README and official stackdid walkthrough; direct NBER open403. Latest2026 revision full PDF not compared.
sources.application_limit: Requires real adoption cohorts and clean controls throughout each window; unweighted stacking generally targets neither trimmed ATT nor another causal average.

sources.title: Better Understanding Triple Differences Estimators
sources.direct_scope: author60-page PDF pp1–4 and framework/estimation sections; metadata; official package setup/README. No proof audit or execution.
sources.application_limit: Two binary enabling/eligibility conditions. The paper p4 explicitly distinguishes subgroup-effect heterogeneity DDD, so continuous B interactions are not a turnkey application.

sources.title: A More Credible Approach to Parallel Trends
sources.direct_scope: published PDF pp2555–2557 and model/restriction discussion; official README relative-magnitude/smoothness explanation; no code replication
sources.application_limit: Input vector/covariance and bias decomposition must be valid for fixed target; bounded PT deviations do not cover arbitrary policy shocks or invalid treatment definitions.

sources.title: Synthetic Difference-in-Differences
sources.direct_scope: official publication metadata/abstract; author arXiv introduction, block treatment and factor conditions; official package block-matrix restriction
sources.version_caution: Unpinned arXiv HTML displays v4 metadata July2021 but a cover string Version August2026. Do not treat this as independently verified new2026 publication.
sources.application_limit: Original official package targets binary common-onset block ATT; continuous B slope and group-wide spillovers are not solved.

sources.title: Generalized Synthetic Control Method: Causal Inference with Interactive Fixed Effects Models
sources.direct_scope: publisher full text §§2–3 including assumptions2–5, factor model, CV and inference; official package manual latest overview
sources.application_limit: Long pretreatment panel and correct factor model needed; cross-section error independence/variance conditions depend on inference route. Short aggregate annual series cannot support arbitrary factors.

sources.title: Matrix Completion Methods for Causal Panel Data Models
sources.publication: Journal of the American Statistical Association116(536)(2021):1716–1730; DOI10.1080/01621459.2021.1891924
sources.direct_scope: author arXiv full text introduction/setup, missingness patterns, nuclear-norm objective/CV; author institution search result verifies journal bibliography (direct page403)
sources.application_limit: Low-rank imputation still requires causal assumptions on treatment selection and latent outcome structure; mask construction is not a substitute.
